# The throttle order past 80%

At `slow-sweeps` every earlier level also applies: paid newest checks run every 2 h (Chichester's ran 2 h ago: due), free-only ones every 4 h (Belfast's ran 3 h ago: not due), and sweeps every 48 h (Chichester's ran 25 h ago: not due; Belfast's 49 h ago: due, and its newest check is not, so it takes the region's run).
